theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bh_rescaled_volume_lower
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (c₂ ρ₂ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (F ∩ ball y ρ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (ball y ρ \ F)) → ∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < r → r * s < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * s ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume ((fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c₂ * s ^ (m + 1)) ≤ volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ (fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
